Help

Answers to the usual questions, and fixes for when something isn't working.

The site
The loading plane never lands, or the page stays blank
The first visit after a quiet spell can take up to half a minute while the timetable wakes up. If it's still stuck:
  1. Refresh the page (Ctrl+Shift+R on a computer, ⌘+Shift+R on a Mac, or pull down on a phone).
  2. Still stuck? Use Reload the timetable on this page — it fetches a fresh copy and leaves your trips alone.
  3. Try another browser or turn off content blockers for this site.
I'm seeing an old version after an update
The site keeps a copy of itself so it opens with no signal. Close every TerraLink tab and open it again — the new version loads the next time you're online. If it still looks old, use Clear the offline copy on this page.
Something on the page looks broken or doesn't respond
Refresh first. If it keeps happening, it's usually a browser extension (ad blockers, privacy tools, translators) changing the page — try a private window. TerraLink works in current Chrome, Edge, Safari and Firefox; very old browsers aren't supported.
Installing TerraLink as an app
  • iPhone or iPad: open the site in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
  • Android: in Chrome, tap ⋮ then Install app (or Add to Home screen).
  • Computer: in Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right of the address bar.
Does it work offline?
Once you've opened TerraLink with a connection, the timetable, My trips and boarding passes open with no signal. The live map, weather, Flight status for flights in the air, and signing in need a connection.
Switching between light and dark
Use the round ◐ button at the top right. Match device follows your phone or computer's setting; Light and Dark stay put whatever the device does.
Booking and trips
My search says no flights
Check the dates: some routes don't fly every day — a route page shows which days. Try a nearby airport (Newark for New York, say), or a different date. Searches include connections with at least 45 minutes and at most 12 hours between flights; a connection outside that isn't sold.
Where did my booking go?
Bookings are in My trips. If you weren't signed in when you booked, the trip is kept in that browser only — another browser, another device or a private window won't show it, and clearing your browsing data removes it. Sign in before booking to keep trips with your account.
The times look wrong
Every time on TerraLink is local to the airport it's at: departures in the departure city's time, arrivals in the arrival city's. A small +1 means it lands the next day.
Adding a trip to my calendar
On an upcoming trip, choose Add to calendar. A calendar file downloads; open it and your phone or computer adds each flight. For Google Calendar on a computer, import the file from Settings → Import & export.
What currency are the prices?
Fares are in the game's currency. Nothing on TerraLink charges a real card.
Flight status and maps
Flight status can't find my flight
Search with the airline code and number together, like UA869 or SR395; an aircraft registration; an airport code like IAH; or a route like IAH-LHR.
The map is grey or empty
The map pictures come from OpenStreetMap. A slow connection, an ad blocker or a work network can stop them loading — refresh, or allow the site in your blocker. Planes and routes still show on top.
“What's that plane? Near me” doesn't work
It needs permission to use your location. In Chrome, click the icon left of the address and allow Location; on iPhone, go to Settings → Privacy → Location Services → Safari Websites. Your location stays in your browser — it isn't sent anywhere.
Weather says it isn't available
The forecast comes from Open-Meteo. If it can't be reached the card says so; try again in a few minutes.
Account
I can't sign in
Check the email and password (passwords are case-sensitive). A new account has to be confirmed from the email that's sent before the first sign-in. If Google or Discord brings you back signed out, try again in a normal (not private) window with cookies allowed, or use email and password.
It says sign-in needs the hosted site
Sign-in only works on terralinkgroup.github.io, not on a saved copy of the page.
Is TerraLink a real airline?
No — it's a fan-built booking site for airlines in a game. No real tickets are sold and it isn't affiliated with any real airline.
Nothing matches that. Try a shorter word.

TerraClub

One membership across all seven carriers. Earn points on every mile you fly, and keep them wherever you fly next.

Join TerraClub
Points are held on your account, not in this browser — so they follow you to your phone and can't be lost. Sign in or create an account to start earning.

Tiers

Seven rungs, named for altitude. Each one adds a bonus on everything you earn.

How you earn

Five points for every dollar of fare. Premium cabins earn more because they cost more.

Using your points

Any seat, any flight — an award costs whatever the fare costs, converted at 1.2¢ a point. Taxes are paid in cash. At five points a dollar, roughly seventeen paid trips cover a free one of the same value.

Award tickets don't earn points. Seats are subject to availability in the cabin you choose.

Lounges

Group airlines have lounges at their hubs, at the other TerraLink hubs they fly to and at major airports around the world — somewhere quiet before you fly, with food, showers and Starlink Wi-Fi.
